about: Weapon type (the codex's sub-category tab) for weapons the ITEM_* alias cannot type -- mostly legendaries. Read off the Codex of Equipment tab screenshots by pixel-matching each grid cell (greyscale correlation for Unowned cells) and mapping the sprite to its item through icon_map.json. 'source' says whether that icon link is confirmed or derived. Every alias-typed weapon that appeared in these grids sat in its own tab (~95 checks, 0 misses), which is what makes the tab trustworthy.
